# Ordered fragment manifest for ship-issue/workflow.js (#806).
#
# EDIT THE FRAGMENTS, NOT THE ARTIFACT. ../workflow.js is generated by
# concatenating the files below IN THIS ORDER — an edit made directly to it is
# overwritten by the next `just gen-workflow-js`, and until then
# tests/lint-workflow-js-generated.sh fails the tree as stale.
#
# THE ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING, WHICH IS WHY THIS LIST IS EXPLICIT AND NOT A GLOB.
# Two constraints it encodes, both of which fail in ways a casual test misses:
#
#   00-meta.js MUST stay first. The engine rejects a script whose
#   `export const meta` is not the very first statement.
#
#   20-sanitize.js MUST precede 30-dimensions.js. The `scope-drift` entry of
#   NEW_DIMENSIONS calls `sanitize(issue.title)` at MODULE LOAD. Reversed, that
#   is a temporal-dead-zone throw — but only on the branch where `issue` is
#   truthy, so a test that extracts without an issue stays green while the real
#   run dies. That is #260, exactly. tests/workflow-helpers/ship-issue/
#   04-tdz-and-diff.mjs pins the live branch.
#
# The generator checks this list against the directory in BOTH directions: a
# listed fragment missing on disk fails, and an unlisted `.js` sitting in this
# directory fails too — the second is the dangerous one, since it is a file
# someone edits believing it ships while the artifact holds none of its bytes.
# Same contract, same reasoning, as tests/lib/fragments.sh.

00-meta.js                # export const meta — must be the FIRST statement
05-provenance.js          # size/provenance header + the `args` contract prose
10-args-contract.js       # KNOWN_ARG_KEYS, arg validation, config consts
20-sanitize.js            # sanitize, stableStringify, dataBlock — before 30
30-dimensions.js          # REUSED_DIMENSIONS, NEW_DIMENSIONS (calls sanitize)
40-budget-guards.js       # BUDGET_FLOOR, TAIL_FLOOR, tailAgent, attempt
50-schemas-finding.js     # CERTAINTY / FINDING / MANIFEST / FINDINGS_SCHEMA
55-disposition-policy.js  # NATURE_VALUES, DISPOSITION_RULES, tallies
60-schemas-judge.js       # JUDGE_SCHEMA, COMMENTS_SCHEMA
70-prompts.js             # READONLY, SCOPE_DISCIPLINE, prompt builders
72-verdicts.js            # refOf, dispositionOf, applyJudgeVerdicts, clean
74-narrowing.js           # re-review narrowing, dimension selection, emptyResult
80-orchestration.js       # the side-effecting body (past ORCH_BOUNDARY)
